about: The alleluia of the formulary “Nativity of the Lord — Mass at Dawn” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

s01.translation: Alleluia, alleluia. The Lord has reigned, He has clothed Himself with beauty; the Lord has clothed Himself with strength and has girded Himself with power. Alleluia.

alignments.gloss: the Lord has put on strength
